items.name: 诡术师之镜
items.description:
Summon a clone with @HealthPercent@% max Health and +@ManaIncrease*100@% max Mana. You cannot equip items to the clone.

The clone benefits from active traits

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
召唤一个拥有@HealthPercent@%最大生命值并且最大法力值+@ManaIncrease*100@%的复制体。你无法给复制体装上装备。

复制体会受益于已激活的羁绊。

[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]

items.name: 迷离风衣
items.description:
Once per combat at @PercentHealthTrigger@% Health, the holder splits into 3 copies of themself each with @PercentHealthOfCopies@% of their max Health.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
每回合一次，在@PercentHealthTrigger@%生命值时，携带者分裂为自己的3个复制体，每个都有拥有其@PercentHealthOfCopies@%最大生命值。

[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]

items.name: 幽魂弯刀
items.description: Combat start: Teleport the holder to the mirrored hex on the enemy's side of the board. After @Duration@ seconds, the holder returns to their original location.
items.chineseDescription: 战斗开始时：将携带者传送到敌方一侧的镜像格上。在@Duration@秒后，携带者返回其原本的位置。

items.name: 鱼骨头
items.description: Doubles the holder's attack range, and causes each of their attacks to target a random enemy.
items.chineseDescription: 将携带者的攻击距离翻倍，并且使其每次攻击都会将一个随机的敌人作为目标。

items.name: 死亡之蔑
items.description:
@IgnorePainPercent@% of the damage the holder receives is instead dealt over @BleedDuration@ seconds as non-lethal damage.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
携带者受到的@IgnorePainPercent@%伤害会转而在@BleedDuration@秒里作为非致命伤害来持续扣除。

[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]

items.name: 金币收集者
items.description:
Attacks and Abilities execute enemies below @ExecutePercent@% of their maximum Health. Executions have a @GoldChance@% chance to drop %i:goldCoins% 1 gold.

Gold Collected: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Tracker_Value1@g
[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
携带者的攻击和技能会处决低于@ExecutePercent@%最大生命值的目标。处决有@GoldChance@%几率掉落%i:goldCoins%1金币。

已收集的金币： @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Tracker_Value1@金币
[唯一 - 每个弈子仅可装备1件]

items.name: 投机者之刃
items.description:
Grant %i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeedPerGold*100@% bonus Attack Speed per %i:goldCoins% gold in your bank (up to %i:goldCoins% @AttackSpeedGoldLimit@ gold).

Each attack has a @ChanceToProc*100@% chance to drop %i:goldCoins% @GoldPerProc@ gold.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
Gold generated this game: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@
items.chineseDescription:
获得 %i:scaleAS% @AttackSpeedPerGold*100@% x你的 %i:goldCoins% 金币存款的攻击速度(在 %i:goldCoins% @AttackSpeedGoldLimit@金币时达到最大值)。

每次攻击有@ChanceToProc*100@%几率掉落%i:goldCoins% @GoldPerProc@金币。

[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]
这局游戏已生成的金币：@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@

items.name: 大亨之铠
items.description:
Grants @BaseResistsPerStack@ Armor, @BaseResistsPerStack@ Magic Resist, and @BaseHealthPerStack@ Health when taking damage, stacking up to @StackCap@ times.

At full stacks, grant %i:goldCoins% @GoldAtFullStacks@ gold and continue gaining %i:goldCoins% 1 gold every @GoldInterval@ seconds.

Gold generated this game: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@
[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
在承受伤害时提供@BaseResistsPerStack@护甲、@BaseResistsPerStack@魔抗和@BaseHealthPerStack@生命值，这个效果至多叠加@StackCap@次。

在满层时，提供%i:goldCoins%@GoldAtFullStacks@金币并且每@GoldInterval@秒继续提供%i:goldCoins% 1金币。

这局游戏已生成的金币：@TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@
[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]

items.name: 静止法衣
items.description:
Combat start: Shoot a beam that @CostIncrease@% Mana Reaves enemies.

Your team gains @BonusAllyHealth@ Health.

[Support item] [Unique - only 1 per champion]
Mana Reave: increase maximum Mana until the next cast
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@
items.chineseDescription:
战斗开始时：射出一道光束，对敌人们施加@CostIncrease@%破法。

己方获得@BonusAllyHealth@生命值。

[辅助装][唯一 - 每位英雄仅可装备一件]
破法：最大法力值提升，持续到施放技能为止。
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@

items.name: 灵风
items.description:
Combat start: Summon a whirlwind on the opposite side of the arena that removes the closest enemy from combat for @BanishDuration@ seconds.

Your team gains @AllyBonusAS@% Attack Speed.

[Support item]
[Ignores crowd control immunity.]
[Unique - only 1 per champion]
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@
items.chineseDescription:
战斗开始时：在棋盘对面召唤一道飓风，来将与飓风相距最近的那个敌人移出战斗@BanishDuration@秒。

己方获得@AllyBonusAS@%攻击速度。

[辅助装]
[无视控制免疫效果。]
[唯一 - 每位英雄仅可装备一件]
@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT_BindOnEquipTRA@

items.name: 兹若特传送门
items.description:
Summon a large Voidspawn. Its strength increases with each Stage.

​​[Support item]
[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.chineseDescription:
召唤一个大型虚空生物。它的强度会在每个阶段提升。

​​[辅助装]
[唯一 - 每位英雄仅限1件]
